_about: The OmniBots doctor's reference: every folder, file, dependency and setting OmniBots and Omni need to work together. The doctor (python -m omnibots.doctor, Settings -> Doctor, or Omi's call_doctor tool) checks each entry, and repairs the ones marked fix. Paths use {tokens}: {home} = %OMNIBOTS_HOME% or ~/.omnibots; {omni} = Omni's install folder (~/.omni); {omni_home} = %OMNI_HOME% or {omni}/agent; {config} = {home}/config (OmniBots' own provider config, only when Omni isn't installed); {appdata} = %LOCALAPPDATA%/OmniBots; {output} = [output] folder in settings.toml. Explained in README.md (The doctor).

allowed_roots._about: The only places OmniBots and Omni keep config, keys and data. Anything that looks like their config somewhere else is reported (never deleted).

folders.why: OmniBots' home: code, data and settings
the SQLite database (and the encrypted provider keys)
Qt's cache for the window (qtpipelinecache); Qt makes it slower to start without it
where the bots' projects go (chosen on first start)

files.why: the database, at the newest schema

omni._about: Checked read-only. The doctor never changes Omni's files; Omni's own /doctor looks after Omni.

files.why: Omni's project config (skills, MCP servers, extensions)
the providers and keys both apps share

standalone._about: Used only when Omni isn't installed: the same file formats as Omni's home. Keys are never in these files; they're DPAPI-encrypted in the provider_keys table of {home}/db/omnibots.sqlite.

files.why: providers and models, in Omni's settings.json format, no keys
Omni's .env format; keys typed here are moved into the encrypted store
skills and MCP servers, in Omni's format

packages.why: the window and the tray icon
the bots' secrets in Windows Credential Manager

env.name: OMNIBOTS_HOME
env.why: moves OmniBots' data; only set it on purpose

env.name: OMNIBOTS_DIR
env.why: where Omni's /omnibots looks for the code

legacy.why: the old install location (only Qt's cache belongs there now)
a loose .env in the user folder; keys belong in ~/.omni or OmniBots' store

providers._about: At least one provider with a key, the default provider usable, no errors. Online test (optional): GET <baseUrl>/models with the key, 10 s timeout. Keys are never shown, only masked.
